newsitem.title: USA: Schnitzer Steel raises offer for Proler.
newsitem.headline: Schnitzer Steel raises offer for Proler.

text.p: Schnitzer Steel Industries Inc said Friday that it has increased the offer price in its tender offer to purchase all outstanding shares of Proler International Corp to $9.00 per share in cash and extended its tender offer until 12:00 p.m., Eastern time on Friday, November 29.
Schnitzer said the 10-day extension is required by Securities and Exchange Commission regulations when the offer price is changed.
On September 15, 1996 Schnitzer and Proler signed a definitive merger agreement for the acquisition of Proler by a cash tender offer and merger at a price of $7.50 in cash for each Proler share.
Thursday Proler said it has received a revised offer from Hugo Neu Corp to acquire it that no longer includes financing, but continues to consider Schnitzer's offer "superior."
Proler was up 7/8 at 8-7/8 in mid-morning trading, making it one of the top percentage gainers so far Friday on the New York Stock Exchange.
